about: The sit-stand networks' seat (neuro/seatcal.py): the legs' load (proprio's raw units, the simulator's leg-force proxy) seated on the floor, the median over every seated tick at least 2 s after robotd's sit label, and how long after the label the seat-down unload lasts; live robotd in the simulator (real_home, 20 ms servo command delay), free roam 2 x 30 min + sit/stand 2 x 40 cycles (V8Compare records, 2026-11-05/06; v5 50 sit-downs / 22969 seated ticks, v8 56 / 33128) and 20 page sit-downs per arm (V8Fix seatcal, 2026-11-06). The reference is the seat the lift numbers were set on.
about_stances: The walk networks' standing stance (neuro/seatcal.py), proprio's raw units, 50 Hz neuro records of the live robotd in the simulator (real_home, 20 ms servo command delay): floor_low = the lowest load the legs stayed under for 0.3 s standing stopped on the floor (v8: 9.9 h of V8Fix, V8Brush and BrushModel roam / wall / righting / trick records, 2026-11-05/06; v5: 8.1 h of the same rigs: 19.3); held = the median load standing in the world's hand (V8Fix lift rig, 16 lifts, 480 in-hand ticks before the claim; ≤ 12.5 once the lift's swing is over); lift_load = the standing claim's level between them. v9 (V9Safety, 2026-11-10): its stance itself stays above 20, but a v9 duck standing with its beak resting on a thing (a basket, a sofa's edge) carries 17.2-19.9 on its legs for seconds and proprio's 20 claimed a pickup (4 in 3.0 h of headless roam, 1 in 0.5 h of live roam; floor_low 17.7 / 17.8); in the hand its legs settle at about 10 as v8's. The reference walk keeps proprio's own level (20.0).
